about: Who says each episode's title quote, for A13 part 2's proof (scripts/dev-test/facts-asks.js score): the truth a re-asked episode's episodeFacts.titleQuote is scored against. Names as the source gives them; matched to the cast the forgiving way (episode-facts.js personIn). An episode not listed has no truth on file (its answer counts for how often research says it, not whether it's right).

survivor/49.source: Inside Survivor's weekly stats pages (insidesurvivor.com, 'Survivor 49 - Episode N Stats': "The episode title ... was said by ..."), read 2026-10-31; episodes 1 and 7 have no page found
